power_mode.name: MODE_30W
power_mode.evidence: sudo nvpmodel -q executed immediately after the benchmark
power_mode.limitation: The benchmark script did not capture nvpmodel at run start; this is a post-run observation.

observations: All five measured runs produced non-empty output and exited with code 0.
All five measured runs reported 37/37 layers offloaded to CUDA0.
No CUDA, OOM, GGUF, tokenizer, or invalid-argument error was found in measured stderr logs.
VDD_GPU_SOC is a reported Jetson power rail and must not be presented as total module power.
The short benchmark cannot establish long-duration thermal stability or absence of throttling.
